source_doc.title: IQE FY2025 results — completed MACOM investment and long-term supply agreements
source_doc.permission_basis: Public issuer regulatory announcement; retain the canonical URL and only research-relevant excerpts.

sources.quote: The fundraise included a £45m strategic investment from MACOM Technology Solutions Inc. ... £30m of equity and £15m in new non-interest bearing convertible loan notes.
Concurrently, IQE and MACOM also entered into long-term supply agreements.
IQE is seeing accelerated demand for the Group’s InP solutions, which support optical photonics products for data centre and AI infrastructure

claims.statement: MACOM, an IQE customer, completed a £45 million strategic investment in IQE through £30 million of equity and £15 million of non-interest-bearing convertible notes; IQE and MACOM concurrently entered long-term supply agreements.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if IQE or MACOM terminates or materially narrows the supply agreements, MACOM exits the investment, or future disclosures show no commercial orders or volume production attributable to the agreements.

claims.statement: IQE reported accelerated demand for InP solutions supporting optical photonics for data-centre and AI infrastructure, but did not disclose the MACOM agreement's product mix, committed purchase volume, revenue, duration, or exclusivity.
claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade the AI/InP interpretation if later disclosures assign the MACOM agreements primarily to unrelated product lines or show no production conversion.
